listAsq.title: What if I don't like your offer?
listAsq.content: Our service is designed for evaluation only - there's absolutely no obligation to sell. If our price doesn't meet your expectations, that's completely understandable. We guarantee no spam, no pressure, and no sales tactics. Our role is simply to provide a fair quote, and the decision remains entirely yours. We're also open to negotiation if you'd like to discuss the price.

listAsq.title: How quickly can you arrive?
listAsq.content: In most cases, we provide same-day service. Occasionally, appointments may be scheduled for the next day depending on time of day, holidays, or if specialized transportation is required for larger items. We'll confirm your appointment time when you contact us.

listAsq.title: What condition does my item need to be in?
listAsq.content: To be honest, damaged items rarely hold significant value. However, we are interested in high-value items that can be repaired or used for parts. This includes cameras, laptops, scooters, and vehicles - we're happy to discuss the specifics with you and evaluate whether we can make an offer.

listAsq.title: Is this safe and secure?
listAsq.content: Our mission is to make selling simple and straightforward. We help you sell without the hassle of posting on marketplace platforms, managing messages, arranging meetings, or handling shipping. After your online evaluation, rest assured your information will never be shared with third parties, and you'll never receive spam or promotional emails from us.
